author: Pallas, 1811
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 하천 바닥, 강가 초지, 키 큰 풀숲, 관목림

months.note: 5~6월과 8~10월 이동기에 지나가고 겨울에도 드물게 기록되며, 번식지에서는 6월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 작은 무리를 지어 한반도 전역을 지나가는 흔하지 않은 나그네새이다. 하천 바닥이나 강가 초지에 살며 특히 키 큰 풀숲이나 관목림을 좋아하고, 작은 곤충과 그 유충을 먹는다. 초습지의 풀 사이 땅 위에 둥지를 틀고 6월에 한배에 4~6개의 알을 낳는다. 시베리아와 동아시아 북부에서 번식하고 중국, 인도차이나, 미얀마, 말레이반도 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.ko: 검은 세로무늬가 많은 누런 갈색 윗면

young: 어른새와 비슷하나 아랫면에 노란 기가 돌고, 멱 아래와 윗가슴에 점 같은 짧은 검은 갈색 세로무늬가 있다. 꼬리 끝의 흰 무늬는 어른새보다 작고 흐리다.

similar.how: 쥐발귀개개비는 더 작고 가슴과 옆구리에 가는 세로무늬가 촘촘하며, 꼬리 끝에 흰 무늬가 없다.
알락꼬리쥐발귀는 머리와 등에 검은 세로무늬가 거의 없는 민무늬이고 흰 눈썹선도 흐리다.

art.subject: Pallas's Grasshopper Warbler (Locustella certhiola), adult on passage (sexes alike): crown and mantle yellowish- to rufous-brown, heavily streaked black; a long, fairly prominent greyish-white supercilium and a dark brown eye-stripe; rump and uppertail coverts warmer rufous-brown with fewer streaks; wings brown, the tertials blackish-centred with whitish tips; tail dark brown becoming blackish towards the end, all but the central feathers tipped greyish-white; underparts greyish-white, washed buff-brown on the breast sides, flanks and long undertail coverts; bill dark with a pale base to the lower mandible; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: skulking low in tall grass, side view
art.scene: Korean riverside grassland with tall grass and scattered shrubs during migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched low on a grass stem: heavily black-streaked yellowish-brown upperparts, long greyish-white supercilium, dark eye-stripe, greyish-white underparts with buff flanks, dark tail with whitish tips, pink legs

adult, seen from above on the ground with both wings folded neatly along the back: black-streaked yellowish-brown crown and back, warmer rufous-brown rump, white-tipped tertials, blackish tail with greyish-white feather tips
art.build: Small but robust grasshopper warbler, about 13cm — about sparrow length but slimmer, larger and heavier than Lanceolated Warbler. Flat crown and a slender, pointed bill shorter than the head. Legs pinkish and strong. Wings short; at rest the wingtips reach only a short way past the base of the tail. Tail broad, rounded and fairly long, with long undertail coverts. Skulks low in tall grass and shrubs, creeping and running; when flushed it drops quickly back into cover, showing the rufous rump and dark, white-tipped tail.
avoid: Do not paint the tail plain brown; it darkens towards the end and the outer feathers have greyish-white tips.
Do not streak the breast heavily; that is Lanceolated Warbler (Locustella lanceolata).
Do not paint a plain, unstreaked back like a reed warbler or Styan's Grasshopper Warbler.
